text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan says in speech new two-chamber parliament will open its session in October.
- United Nations Secretary General Kofi Annan considers reducing staff of the U.N. Mission for Referendum in Western Sahara.
- King Hassan meets Saudi Foreign Minister Saud al-Faisal.
- Mexican senate team arrived for a three-day working visit in Rabat at invitation of Moroccan parliament.
- King Hassan pardons 1,522 prisoners on Throne Day.
